HediffDef.label: psyche scar
HediffDef.description: A permanent mark left by trauma that never fully healed. It lowers the maximum psyche health this person can hold.

HediffDef.label: grief psyche scar
HediffDef.description: The absence of someone loved, worn permanently into the mind. What death took does not come back, and the missing weight is always there to be felt.

HediffDef.label: apostasy psyche scar
HediffDef.description: A belief broken by one's own hand. The act cannot be unmade, and the memory of betraying what one holds sacred settles permanently into the mind.

HediffDef.label: bloodguilt psyche scar
HediffDef.description: Harm done to another living being, against everything one believes. The weight of it never fully lifts.

HediffDef.label: callousness psyche scar
HediffDef.description: Someone in need was turned away. The guilt of the refusal lingers, a permanent doubt about one's own humanity.

HediffDef.label: sacred loss psyche scar
HediffDef.description: Something sacred or central to who one is has been taken away. Its absence is a permanent hollow.

HediffDef.label: bereavement psyche scar
HediffDef.description: The loss of one's own child, worn permanently into the mind. A grief a parent never truly sets down.

HediffDef.label: severed bond psyche scar
HediffDef.description: A bond to another living thing, cut and left raw. The connection is gone, but the shape of it remains.

HediffDef.label: unresolved loss psyche scar
HediffDef.description: Someone gone without an ending - not dead, just lost. The mind keeps a place set for a return that may never come.

HediffDef.label: violation psyche scar
HediffDef.description: The body was used against its owner's will. The breach of it settles permanently into the mind.

HediffDef.label: captivity psyche scar
HediffDef.description: Time spent caged or owned, worn permanently into the mind. Freedom returned, but the mark of the cage remains.

HediffDef.label: defilement psyche scar
HediffDef.description: A taboo broken and not undone - flesh consumed, a horror committed. The mind keeps the stain.

HediffDef.label: fractured identity psyche scar
HediffDef.description: The self, made uncertain - a copied mind, a borrowed body, memories that may not be one's own. The question of who one is does not fully close.

HediffDef.label: dishonor psyche scar
HediffDef.description: A disgrace that clings - a defeat or failure that stained one's standing. The shame settles permanently into the mind.

HediffDef.label: psyche clarity
HediffDef.description: A lasting insight won from a profound experience.

HediffDef.label: haunted psyche scar
HediffDef.description: A wound that keeps its grip. The memory intrudes unbidden, dulling the drive to work and pulling this person away from others. At its worst it sends them wandering, lost in the past.

HediffDef.label: hard-won psyche clarity
HediffDef.description: An understanding paid for in pain. Having sat with the worst and come through, this person learns faster and works with a steadier hand.

HediffDef.label: pyromania psyche scar
HediffDef.description: A fixation on flame worn into the mind. It is a lasting mark on the psyche, and only the most advanced therapy can lift it entirely.

HediffDef.label: psychopathy psyche scar
HediffDef.description: A disconnection from others that runs to the core. It shields this person from grief, but the same wall holds everyone at arm's length, weakening the bonds they can form.

HediffDef.label: bloodlust psyche scar
HediffDef.description: A hunger for violence carved into the psyche. It is a lasting mark, and only the most advanced therapy can lift it entirely.

HediffDef.label: chemical fascination psyche scar
HediffDef.description: A pull toward chemical escape that the mind keeps returning to. It is a lasting mark, and only the most advanced therapy can lift it entirely.

HediffDef.label: phantom psyche scar
HediffDef.description: The mind still reaches for a part of the body that is no longer there. The absence never quite stops aching.

HediffDef.label: shell-shocked psyche scar
HediffDef.description: The violence survived did not leave with the battle. It waits just beneath the surface, ready to return.

HediffDef.label: protective dread psyche scar
HediffDef.description: Having watched a loved one broken, the fear of it happening again never fully lets go.

HediffDef.label: artisan's psyche clarity
HediffDef.description: Having made something truly great, this person carries a settled certainty of their own craft.

HediffDef.label: visionary psyche clarity
HediffDef.description: An inspired moment left a lasting clarity of thought behind it, like a light that never fully dimmed.

HediffDef.label: healer's resolve psyche clarity
HediffDef.description: Having pulled someone back from death, this person holds a steadier faith in their own hands.

HediffDef.label: made whole psyche clarity
HediffDef.description: Having turned a crippling loss into a body that feels whole again, this person carries a quiet certainty that even what is taken can be reclaimed.

HediffDef.label: reckoning psyche clarity
HediffDef.description: The one who caused the loss is gone. It does not undo the grief, but something long clenched finally loosens - the debt is settled, and the mind can rest a little easier.

HediffDef.label: peace psyche clarity
HediffDef.description: A loss laid gently to rest. Having buried someone who lived a full life, this person carries the loss without its edge - a settled peace with the way of things.

HediffDef.label: sanguine psyche clarity
HediffDef.description: An innate, level buoyancy of spirit.
